46:t_014:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...That type of person has absolute confidence in their own plans, but they're mentally fragile.」

46:t_014:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If we make a clumsy move, he may fly into a rage and lay hands on the hostages, who are supposed to be his trump card.」

46:t_014:16.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「A petty man of power... In a sense, the most dangerous kind of person.」

46:t_014:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If we can catch him off guard while he's drunk on his own plan...」

46:t_014:18.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Hesitating, are you? Being ruled by such sentiment is the weakness of you Earthlings.」

46:t_014:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$セツコ・オハラ$$ was the same. That's how she bound her own actions, too...」

46:t_014:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Old man, you know $$セツコ$$!?」

46:t_014:21.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I am not an old man! My name is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

46:t_014:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sure enough, $$セツコ$$ and the others were on this Earth.」

46:t_014:23.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Thanks, old man! For telling us something good!」

46:t_014:24.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-well then, take my words with you to the grave. You have no move left to make, after all.」

46:t_014:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You coward! Don't talk big after pulling a cheap trick like taking hostages!」

46:t_014:26.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Truly the howl of a loser. But however much you struggle, your life and death are already in my hands.」

46:t_014:27.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You bastard! Come down here and fight me!」

46:t_014:28.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Knock it off, $$ピニオン$$. ...There's no point saying anything to a fool like that.」

46:t_014:30.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's right. Anyone who relies on a machine and thinks that makes them strong is an idiot, no matter how you look at it.」

46:t_014:31.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「And while I'm at it, guys like that always think they're smart, which makes it even funnier.」

46:t_014:32.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Youuu...!! Are you that eager to die!」

46:t_014:33.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...You're about to have your stupidity proven.」

46:t_015:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting! The fiery mobile suit pilot, $$ガロード・ラン$$, is on the scene!」

46:t_016:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「So worked up that you didn't even notice $$ガロード$$ coming. You really are a fool.」

46:t_016:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're late, $$ガロード$$! If you're coming to save us, come sooner!」

46:t_016:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you've got a complaint, take it up with $$ベローズ$$, who sent me out scouting.」

46:t_016:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ガロード$$, is that you!?」

46:t_016:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah! Long time no see, everyone!」

46:t_016:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What's going on, $$ガロード$$? Do you know those guys?」

46:t_016:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Talk later! The enemy's getting mad!」

46:t_017:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All units, begin the attack! Utterly crush $c and the brat who got in my way!」

46:t_017:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You pull a cowardly trick, and still you talk like a big shot!」

46:t_018:0.en:
$n
「You there, in the Gundam...! I'll cover you!」

46:t_018:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't recognize you, but if you're a member of 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》, you're a friend of mine, too.」

46:t_018:2.en:
$n
「We're $c. A unit that carries on the will of 《$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$》 and 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》.」

46:t_018:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Got it! I'll be counting on you!」

46:t_019:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$'s team has secured the civilians.」

46:t_019:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All that's left is to make that man, $$ギルター$$, pay for his foolish actions.」

46:t_019:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Roger. I will take down the incompetent commander who relied on a cowardly scheme.」

46:t_019:3.en:
$n
「After going that far, don't think you're getting home in one piece...!」

46:t_019:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-well! Seeing your faces makes me sick! I leave the rest to you!」

46:t_020:1.en:
$$柿小路$$
「At this point, I find myself sympathizing with his subordinates.」

46:t_020:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If you're going to hold a grudge, hold it against your selfish boss! All units, begin the attack!」

46:t_020:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! As long as I'm here, I won't let you lay a finger on $$ガルガンティア$$!」

46:t_021:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed, the enemy force is wiped out.」

46:t_021:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Still, that man, $$ギルター$$... He will appear before us again.」

46:t_021:2.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Guys like that are the vindictive type, after all.」

46:t_021:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「First, we'll have to repair the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

46:t_021:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Fortunately, it looks like we can make contact with the people in this area.」

46:t_021:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Leave it to me. I'll guide you to the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

46:t_021:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, that's right. That's my employer.」

46:t_021:8.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$ガロード$$! Before that, there's something you have to do!」

46:t_021:9.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Thanks to those $$サイデリアル$$ goons, our salvage gear got wrecked! So I'm counting on you to haul up the treasure!」

46:t_021:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Got it! I'll finish the job fast and head back to the fleet!」

46:t_022:0.en:
???
(...Checking data... Partial match with a friendly unit confirmed...)

46:t_022:1.en:
???
(After confirming the situation, I will begin reviving the pilot)

46:t_023:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you think the $$サテライトキャノン$$ can only fire at night forever, you're dead wrong!」

46:t_023:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Thanks to the high-capacity capacitor, it can sortie with one shot's worth of energy already charged, and...」

46:t_023:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「These days there are reflector satellites everywhere! Even in the daytime, microwaves from the Moon reach us in two minutes!」

46:t_023:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$サテライトキャノン$$, firing! If you don't want to die, dodge it!!」

46:t_024:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is the $$ダブルエックス$$'s Twin $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

46:t_024:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It gets microwaves sent from the Moon and charges its energy with them, so that's where the name comes from.」

46:t_024:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You can see its power for yourselves, $$サイデリアル$$! Now that you get it, beat it and go home!」

46:t_100:0.en:
$n
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$... For your sake, too, I'll get stronger...)

46:t_100:1.en:
$n
(The power to protect someone, a power that loses to nothing... Together with $$ジェニオン$$, I'll grasp it...!)

46:t_101:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even if we're wounded, even if this is $$翠の地球$$, as long as the ocean is our battlefield, we are not permitted to lose.」

46:t_101:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All hands! Wherever we are, show them that the queen of the sea is this $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$!」

46:t_102:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A green ocean... Not bad.」

46:t_102:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
(Hey... $$モニカ$$...! What's gotten into the Captain?)

46:t_102:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
(I'm sure the ride during atmospheric entry stirred up his blood as a man of the sea...)

46:t_102:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
(A man of the sea...!?)

ダブルエックス.evidence: Gundam DX (GX-9901-DX) is known in Japan as Gundam Double X; 'Double X' is the official English short form. Not in the sheet.
